story.title: MY DREAM. YOUR €2. OUR STORY.
story.p1before: I am not going to tell you a story about charity, and I am not going to try to convince you with illness, drama or some made-up reason why I deserve your money.
story.p1gold: My reason is much simpler: I have dreamed my whole life of an exceptional car, and for me that car is the Lamborghini Urus.
story.p2: My life has not always gone the way I once imagined. I was married, had two children and thought, like so many people, that I more or less knew what my future would look like. Life decided differently. There have been beautiful years, but also difficult ones, years when dreams moved into the background and other things became more important: working, carrying on, starting over and driving the cars that were possible at the time. But some dreams do not disappear, and that Lamborghini Urus is one of them for me.
story.p3before: Of course I know perfectly well what a car like that costs. Putting roughly €400,000 on the table myself is simply not realistic for me. So I could accept that it would always remain a dream,
story.p3gold: or try something completely different once in my life.
story.p4: Not asking one person for €400,000, but asking 200,000 people for €2. That is the whole idea behind My Urus Dream. No major sponsor, no millionaire paying for everything and no sob story, but lots of people each carrying one tiny piece of an almost impossible dream. 200,000 people × €2 = €400,000. For one person, €2 probably changes nothing, but 200,000 times €2 can make something incredible possible.
story.h1: NOT ASKING ONE PERSON FOR €400,000, BUT ASKING 200,000 PEOPLE FOR €2.

rest.text: NOT ASKING ONE PERSON FOR €400,000, BUT ASKING 200,000 PEOPLE FOR €2.
Maybe you are thinking:
“Why would I give €2 so someone else can buy a Lamborghini?”
A fair question.
I am not claiming that I need a Lamborghini, that I deserve it or that my dream is more important than anyone else's.
I am simply trying something almost everyone will say is impossible.

But imagine it does work. Imagine 200,000 ordinary people, who do not even know one another, together making something happen that is completely out of reach for one ordinary person. Then this is no longer just about a car, but about what becomes possible when lots of people all do one very small thing.
And that is exactly where the difficulty begins. Maybe you think:
“If enough other people pay €2, he will get there.”
But if everyone thinks someone else will do it, nothing happens.
It only works if the person reading this right now thinks:
“Come on, for €2 I will join.”
I am not asking for much: one minute of your time. Click ‘Join for €2’, enter your name and scan the QR code; the payment goes through the official payment system. Done.
And what is €2 today? A beer, soft drink or coffee often costs more. Skip one drink and you may even come out ahead financially, but here you also get something extra:
you become a small part of this story and, if this completely crazy dream becomes reality, you can say: “I was part of it.”
AND MAYBE YOU WILL DRIVE THE URUS YOURSELF
If the campaign succeeds, I want to share the dream too. As you can read elsewhere on this website:
four weekends with the Lamborghini Urus will be given away. Two weekends will be decided by a draw.
That means someone who simply contributes €2 once also has a chance to hold the keys.
The other two weekends I will not leave only to luck: you can influence those yourself.

You contribute €2 yourself once and can then invite other people to take part too. If someone contributes through you, you earn points. And if that person then spreads the story further and new people join through him or her, that earns you points as well.
Your one entry can become the beginning of an entire chain.
The two participants who eventually collect the most points each win a weekend with the Lamborghini Urus.
LET THE STORY GO VIRAL
And that is actually my second dream with this project: not only to make that Urus happen, but to discover
how far we can take this story together.
Share your personal link with friends, family and colleagues via WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok or anywhere you like. Simply tell them:
“There is someone trying to make a Lamborghini Urus happen by getting 200,000 people to contribute €2 each.”
Maybe people laugh and say:
“He is completely crazy.”
Fine. But maybe afterwards they also think:
“You know what? For €2 I want to see whether he can do it.”
And that is exactly what can make this story big. First ten people, then a hundred, a thousand, ten thousand... Maybe it starts living on social media, gets shared by someone with a large reach and
one day this wildly crazy story even reaches the media.
“I was there. I joined in. I helped get this story rolling.”
And who knows, maybe in the end you are even one of the four people who actually gets to drive the Urus.
SO I HAVE ONE MORE QUESTION FOR YOU
If you have read this far, you have probably already spent more time on my dream than it takes to actually take part. So do not think:
“Someone else will pay that €2.”
because that other person may be thinking exactly the same thing.
It only works if you think:
“Come on. Why not?”

One minute, one small payment, €2. Not because I told you a sad story or claim I have a right to a Lamborghini, but simply because you may find the idea just as crazy, funny and exciting as I do, and because you are curious about the answer to one question:
CAN 200,000 PEOPLE WITH €2 EACH MAKE ONE ALMOST IMPOSSIBLE DREAM COME TRUE?
Maybe it never works. Maybe it becomes one huge failure that I can laugh about later.
But maybe it does work.
And if I ever stand in front of that Lamborghini Urus, I will know it is not there thanks to one wealthy donor, but thanks to thousands of people who all thought the same thing:
“COME ON. FOR €2 I WILL JOIN.”

Then lots of people, with one tiny action, will have made one person incredibly happy. Maybe you were one of them, maybe you helped make the story big, and maybe you even end up behind the wheel yourself.
But someone has to start. Why not you?

faq.title: FAQ

items.a: No. This is not a charity, not an investment and not a promise of profit. myurusdream.be is an open, personal campaign: one initiator asks for voluntary €2 contributions to make a car dream possible.
Because €2 is a small, one-time amount for most people. Not asking one person for €400,000, but letting 200,000 people each carry €2 of that dream: 200,000 × €2 = €400,000.

To this personal campaign, with the goal of making a Lamborghini Urus possible. The gross goal of €400,000 is not automatically the purchase price of the car. The counter shows gross received contributions minus transaction costs. The breakdown is on Follow everything.

items.q: What happens if €400,000 is not reached?
items.a: There is no guarantee that the goal will be reached. If it is not reached, your support remains: €2 contributions and sponsorship money are not refunded. Depending on the amount raised, that money goes toward another vehicle. The campaign may be extended or stopped after the end date.

The personal contribution is always €2, but you may repeat it as often as you like. Every extra payment is +5 points and an extra draw number. Larger amounts go through sponsorship (from €500) or the Pixelwall (from €10).
No. Nothing is ever collected automatically again. You make every extra €2 contribution yourself, whenever you want.

A contribution is a one-time, voluntary payment. €2 and sponsorship money are in principle not refunded. Duplicate payments or obvious mistakes can be refunded after review. More information is on the Refunds page.
The counter only counts confirmed payments. The total shown is gross minus transaction costs. No fictional amounts are shown. Everyone can follow the status on the homepage and on Follow everything.
Payments run through Mollie. myurusdream.be does not store card or Bancontact details. Only a confirmed status from the payment provider counts for the counter.

items.q: How would a possible prize draw work?
items.a: Only if the €400,000 goal is reached. Then there are four weekends with the car: two for those who share the most (highest points), two through a live draw. Without a reached goal, there is no draw and no weekend.
Two weekends go to the highest points. The other two are chosen by chance from the draw list: every €2 is a separate number, ten payments means ten chances. Everything can be followed live.
Participation is intended for adults who accept the terms and voluntarily pay €2. The exact rules are in the general terms.

items.q: What conditions apply to driving the car?
items.a: Not applicable yet. Any use requires a valid driving licence, insurance and separate usage terms.
Not decided yet. That will be included in the prize draw usage terms if the goal is reached.
The organiser is responsible for legally correct insurance of the vehicle if it is purchased. Details will follow in the usage terms.
Not applicable yet. Damage, excess and liability belong in separate usage terms if a weekend with the car takes place.

items.q: What happens if the car has not been delivered yet?
items.a: The status of purchase and delivery is shown on Follow everything. There is no promise of a delivery date.
We ask only what is needed: email, name, mobile number and payment status. Mollie processes payments; we do not receive card numbers. Newsletters are never pre-ticked. See the privacy policy.

items.q: How can I get in touch?
items.a: Through the contact page. The organiser's details are listed there.

Yes. Brands contribute an amount of their choice, from €500. The larger the amount, the larger the spot on the site: Bronze €500, Silver €2,500, Gold €10,000, Main sponsor €25,000. The amount counts toward the campaign goal.

A wall of small squares. Self-employed people buy a square, or a larger block, from €10 with a logo, name and optional link. The more squares, the larger the ad. The amount counts toward the campaign goal.

items.q: When are the four weekends awarded?
items.a: Only if the €400,000 goal is reached: live on Saturday 31 October 2026, at a spectacular location in Belgium, streamed for everyone who participated. Two weekends go to the highest points, two to the draw. The exact location will be announced later.

Every €2 payment gives you 5 points. If you share after your payment via WhatsApp, Facebook or email on the site, your code is in the link: anyone who pays through it keeps 5 points and you get +2. If someone further down your line pays, you get +1. Not paid yet? You can share, but without points.

items.q: How do I log in to my dashboard?
items.a: After your payment, you automatically get a small account and remain logged in on that device. If you are logged out, open the dashboard with the same email address and mobile number as with your payment. Extra €2 payments do not require new details.

Yes. Every extra €2 is five extra points and an extra draw number. Ten payments means ten chances in the live draw. Two weekends go to the highest points, two others are drawn from that draw list — only if the goal is reached.
